name: Abyssal Descent
description: Descend into the Abyssal Depths and explore the ocean trench.

narrative.accept: The Admiral instructs, "We need to descend into the Abyssal Depths. The pressure is immense, but the artifacts down there are priceless."
narrative.complete: "You returned from the darkness. Astounding. The ocean depths hold many secrets."
narrative.hint: Travel to Abyssal Depths and explore it.
